delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Personal profile data will be removed after a waiting period. You will not be able to sign in afterwards.
delete.confirmBody: We will send a code to your email address. After you confirm, deletion is scheduled for at least seven days from now, or seven days after your last confirmed event if that is later. You can cancel until then. Booking history stays available for chefs and operations, but will no longer be linked to your identity.
delete.scheduledDescription: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}. You can keep using peopleeat until then, or cancel.
delete.cancelBody: Your account stays active and will not be deleted automatically.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.passkeysHint: Next time, sign in with Face ID or a fingerprint, without a code.
security.removeBody: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. Other passkeys and sign-in methods stay unchanged.
security.signOutDeviceBody: {device} will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
security.signOutEverywhereBody: All other devices and browsers will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
security.signOutThisBody: You will be signed out on this device and will need to sign in again to access your account.
